Subject: Security discovery: Private/VPC/on-prem options & next steps

Hi John —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning to walk through Acme's requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Recap:
- Primary concern: network isolation for inference workloads and strict data residency for EU and US customers.
- Compliance: you indicated SOC 2 Type II is in progress (expected Q3), GDPR applies; HIPAA not in-scope for current product but may be in future.
- Procurement: procurement + legal will want a vendor security questionnaire, SOC 2 report when available, and a deployment diagram showing VPC connectivity and data flows.

What I'm attaching: redwood-private-deployment.pdf (high-level VPC/on-prem options) and our vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf (fillable copy).

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm the right recipient for the vendor questionnaire (security@acme.com or legal@acme.com).
2) If helpful, complete the questionnaire and return (we can ingest as XLSX or link to our secure form).
3) Share any current network/deployment diagram you can (even whiteboard photo). We can draft an Acme-specific diagram once we see it.
4) We can schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive (network + deployment + auth + KMS) with our infra lead and Marissa (CS) — suggested slots below.

Availability (PDT):
- Thu 3/5 1:00-2:00pm
- Fri 3/6 9:00-10:00am
- Mon 3/9 11:00-12:00pm

If you confirm the questionnaire recipient I will also initiate our internal intake so Legal can prepare a standard MSLA and optional on-prem addendum.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks Marcus — great summary. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Vendor questionnaire: Please send to security@acme.com (that's monitored by our vendor intake team). I'll also forward to legal where needed.
- SOC 2: We have SOC 2 Type II in progress. Current ETA for report: Q3 2026. We can share interim evidence (control summaries) upon reasonable request.
- GDPR: Confirmed applicable (we process EU personal data for EEA customers).
- HIPAA: Not applicable for our current product (we may revisit later).

On deployment: we are interested in both a VPC model (private subnets, NAT + private egress through NGFW) and a fully on-premise air-gapped option for certain regulated lines of business. Primary questions:
1) Can Redwood run in an air-gapped environment with local model storage and no external egress?
2) What are the KMS/HSM integrations for customer-managed keys?

I've attached our partially-filled questionnaire (acme-vendor-sq.xlsx) — note many fields are marked for you to fill. Also attaching a preliminary network diagram (separate email).

We can do the technical deep dive Friday 3/6 9:00am PT. Please confirm and send calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick responses, John. Confirmed for Fri 3/6 9:00am PT — I'll send an invite with a tech agenda.

Short answers to your technical questions: 
- Air-gapped: Yes — we offer a private on-prem package that supports model binaries hosted locally with no outbound egress. It requires an ops install (OOB images + installer) and periodic offline patch bundles. We'll surface the per-environment checklist in the technical deep dive.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and on-prem HSM integrations via PKCS#11 for encryption at rest and TLS key material. We'll include a KMS integration diagram in the deployment appendix.

Action items (from Redwood):
- Marissa will kick off intake and work the vendor questionnaire with your security team.
- Naomi will gather our interim SOC 2 evidence and control summaries to share under NDA.
- I will draft an Acme-specific deployment diagram after we get your network stub.

Marissa/Naomi — can you confirm ownership for those items?

Thanks,
Marcus
